scenes.title: The pull of fascination
scenes.viewerPurpose: Let beauty coexist with justified rejection; Name the book's inquiry into attraction; Move between proof, intimacy, music and spectacle
scenes.composition: Place an attractive public spectacle beside a viewer whose expression remains troubled. Hold the viewer's attention without turning their attraction into a sign of approval. Cut between an elegant proof, an intimate sleeping face, a musical phrase and the public spectacle.

scenes.title: What admiration can justify
scenes.viewerPurpose: Ask what admiration licenses; Situate beauty in minds, bodies and cultural histories; Contrast an inherited possession with its copy
scenes.composition: Keep the admired object visible while a separate question asks what admiration excuses. Show a familiar object with traces of use and cultural history rather than an isolated beauty score. Place the inherited object beside a precise copy, letting their histories remain different.

scenes.title: Look again
scenes.viewerPurpose: Make personal fascination worthy of inquiry; Return to something already beautiful to the viewer
scenes.composition: Let a viewer return to one personally meaningful object and look more closely. End with the object still held in attention, leaving room for both pleasure and judgment.
